alex (docs): opening a tiny PR to harmonize SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries. goals: idiomatic names per language, add a short retry/backoff snippet, and land a one-iteration CI smoke harness. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/903

maria (eng): thanks  I'll review Python + TS. confirm: no API changes, purely doc examples?

jon (sdk): taking Go + a quick pass on TS. naming: stream_generate for py, streamGenerate for TS/Go?

alex (docs): yep  keep idiomatic names. no behavioural changes. pasted compact snippets below so CI harness stays cheap.

alex (docs): ```python
# python: streaming + retry (one-iteration)
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def once():
    async for c in client.stream_generate("Summarize this note", max_tokens=64, retry_policy={"backoff":"exponential","max_retries":2}):
        print(c.text)
        break
asyncio.run(once())
```

alex (docs): ```ts
// typescript: streaming minimal
const s = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'Summarize this note', maxTokens: 64 });
for await (const c of s) { console.log(c.text); break }
// note: very short outputs may be coalesced by the transport
```

alex (docs): ```go
// go: cursor pagination minimal
ctx := context.Background()
iter := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{PageSize: 20})
if iter.Next() { _ = iter.Item() }
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil { /* report */ }
// comment: next_cursor empty at EOF; honor ctx cancellation to stop long flows
```
